Real Madrid sign Nuno Mendes from PSG for £63m.
Atlético Madrid sign Dani Olmo from Barcelona for £52m.
Crystal Palace sign Gabriel from Arsenal for £72m.

inbox.text: One of your defenders and your star man got matching tattoos to celebrate a win. Neither remembers deciding this.
One of your forwards rated his own performance 10 out of 10 in the club app after a 4-0 defeat.

options.label: Make him explain it to the squad

inbox.text: Your star man is selling his own brand of protein cereal in the players lounge. One of your defenders reckons it tastes like drywall.

pending.text: Wolfsburg on paper are a level above you. Realistically, what are you going there for?

options.line: Dull, safe and forgotten by Friday teatime. The board like a man who promises nothing.

decisions.text: Kofi Okonjo (Youth) was shown a straight red against Darmstadt and is banned for 1 match. The club secretary rates an appeal at 40 percent. Win and the ban is wiped. Lose and the panel makes it 2 matches. It has to go in before the next match.
decisions.resolved: No appeal went in before the next match, so the 1 match ban stood.

decisions.text: The board want you at an investors dinner on Thursday. A paper has asked for a long sit down interview the same evening.
decisions.resolved: Nobody answered before the next match, so nothing changed.
